summary.en: Cundi videoPlayer: a native Windows/Linux desktop video wall — up to 64 panes in one window, fed by HTTP(S)-FLV, WS(S)-FLV, HLS, RTMP(S), RTSP(S) or local files, each pane pulling, decoding and reconnecting on its own. Fully local, no account, no server. WHEP (WebRTC) streaming is planned.
